patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used for content sections, pairing large, impactful text blocks with illustrative graphics or user interface mockups.
Alternating background colors (white and dark blue) clearly delineate major content sections, creating a strong visual rhythm down the page.
Prominent, extra-bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, often accompanied by a smaller, uppercase label for contextual information.
A vibrant, clear blue is consistently used for primary calls-to-action and key interactive elements, providing a strong focal point against neutral and dark backgrounds.
The top announcement bar smoothly slides up and out of view upon initial scroll, while the main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport.

technique_notes: The site uses CSS keyframes for subtle UI animations and a video hero (as hinted, though not visible in static images). Scroll-triggered motion for main content sections is minimal, primarily involving a sticky navigation bar and a disappearing announcement banner. Content sections appear to reveal by standard scroll, without complex parallax or fade-ins, relying on clear visual separation and ample spacing.

Content sections are structured with a flexible grid or flexbox, allowing for responsive two-column layouts that place large, impactful text alongside detailed illustrations or product screenshots, maintaining visual balance across different screen sizes.
Interactive elements like buttons and input fields feature subtle rounded corners and a consistent accent color for primary actions, providing clear affordance and a cohesive brand feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, uppercase labels and a clean, legible body text for readability.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on buttons, cards, and UI elements within illustrations, contributing to a soft, modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and balanced padding within content blocks, contributing to a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of isometric, floating UI illustrations with a pastel and neon accent palette sets it apart, creating a playful yet sophisticated visual identity that makes complex AI concepts feel approachable and modern. This unique illustrative style, combined with bold typography and a clean layout, is highly memorable.
